title: Prove restrict Correct
prompt: Implement `long long sum_doubled(const int *restrict a, size_t n)`: add every a[i] twice. Then implement `int ranges_overlap(const void *p1, size_t n1, const void *p2, size_t n2)` returning 1 iff the byte ranges intersect — the check you must run before passing overlapping buffers to a restrict API.

tests.name: overlap detection
tests.hint: Byte counts, memcpy-style: [v, v+12) vs [v+8, v+16) intersect; [v, v+8) vs [v+8, v+16) do not.
